name: @rbtv/capture
description: Dependency manifest for the capture component. ONE package manager (npm), per the one-platform-per-component rule: defuddle-cli is the only element npm resolves. The three Python extractor libraries are HOST SYSTEM elements in rbtv.system — npm cannot express them, and a second manager is not an option. All three are optional: capture degrades to a shorter extractor chain without them and still captures. Declaration only; never published, never installed in place.

install.node: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs
